messages.description: one or more channels to the left side of operation
one or more channels to the right side of operation
sets the right side value, floats only with an argument
one or more channels with the result of the operation

arguments.description: initializes right inlet's value and impedes signal connections

body: [&&~] performs a logical AND on signals: for each sample, it outputs 1 if both the left and the right input are nonzero, and 0 otherwise. Unlike [&&], it doesn't truncate its inputs. With a numeric argument, the right inlet only takes floats.
